description: A small round zen garden dish filled with white sand sits on the table, with a tiny seated figurine and a small pagoda-like ornament inside, and a yellow mini rake nearby. The left hand rests near the rim without touching anything while the right hand holds the yellow rake and drags it in short strokes across the sand on the upper-right side, smoothing and carving parallel curved lines, then lifts and repositions the rake closer to the center to continue raking around the ornaments.
